method: Human-readable visual inspection of neutral final GLB reimport renders, individual LOD0 detail renders and separate mount-ownership vignettes
lod0: PASS: coherent metal/rubber/lens material separation, recessed bumper cup, contact-plane mounting and no missing faces or missing textures. Close views show deliberate modest-poly curvature.
lod1: TECHNICAL PASS; VISUAL LIMITATION: reduced geometry has visible uneven specular highlights and polygonal ring curvature at macro inspection distance, despite source-normal transfer. Suitable only for small on-screen presentation; it is not close-up-equivalent to LOD0.
recommendation: Use LOD1 as ordinary room-distance budget candidate, preferably only while the fixture diameter is <=32 screen pixels; retain LOD0 for larger close-inspection presentation. The 32-pixel guide is a proposed heuristic, not an engine-tested threshold or automatic switch. User art approval remains pending.
placement_scope: Two independent surface vignettes, green door surface owns viewer; tan fixed wall surface owns bumper. Not an actual room layout or game capture.
preview_provenance: LOD0 neutral/detail/mount images rendered from the final unchanged LOD0 geometry before the LOD1-only normal-transfer adjustment. LOD1 image rerendered after that adjustment.
